Select molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name AS pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.max_phase AS max_phase, drug_mechanism.mechanism_of_action AS mechanism_of_action, action_type.action_type AS action_type, target_dictionary.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name AS target_name
Join molecule_dictionary ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_mechanism.molregno
Join drug_mechanism ON drug_mechanism.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Join action_type ON action_type.action_type = drug_mechanism.action_type
Join assays ON assays.assay_id = drug_mechanism.record_id
Join target_dictionary ON target_dictionary.tid = assays.tid
Join compound_structures ON compound_structures.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Filter molecule_dictionary.therapeutic_flag = 1
Filter action_type.action_type = 'POSITIVE ALLOSTERIC MODULATOR'
Filter molecule_dictionary.availability_type = 1
Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name
